name: Oregon OSAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: Oregon: Summit boys and Crater girls win 5A titles
summary: No. 2 Summit won the 5A boys title with 28 points to Crater’s 53, and No. 2 Crater won the 5A girls title with 27 points to Summit’s 99, trading the titles they won a year ago. Summit senior Bjorn Blankenship won the boys race in 14:19.6, the fastest high school 5K in the country this season on MileSplit, 2.7 seconds ahead of Crater’s Garrett Faught. Lincoln’s Ellery Lincoln repeated as 6A girls champion in 16:57.6, and South Eugene’s Yosuke Shibata won the 6A boys race in 14:53.3.
